defaultMaxTurns.description: Default maximum turns for agent conversations

defaultMaxOutputTokens.description: Default maximum output tokens for model responses

systemPrompt.description: Global system prompt prepended to all agent instructions

templateVariables.description: Custom template variables for prompt replacement

format.description: JSON format options for date/time types

defaultChatFontSize.description: Default font size for chat messages in pixels

gitRemote.description: Git remote URL resolved on first build, used for update checks

approvalGuardian.description: Optional AI review layer for approval-bound tool calls

enabled.description: Enable guardian review before human approval

mode.description: Review mode defers denials to a human; enforce mode can hard-deny

model.description: Optional model override for guardian review

distributionProfile.description: Built-in profile name or an inline organization distribution profile

logLevel.description: Minimum severity Station writes to its server logs.

telemetryEnabled.description: Allow documented anonymous product usage telemetry when an endpoint is configured.

registryUrl.description: Source URL for the agents/skills/plugins registry catalog.

defaultLLMProvider.description: Default connected provider used to resolve LLM model options.

defaultEmbeddingProvider.description: Default connected provider used for embeddings.

defaultEmbeddingModel.description: Default embedding model id used for knowledge indexing.

defaultVectorDbProvider.description: Default connected provider used for vector storage.

terminalShell.description: Shell used when Station spawns a terminal session.

disableDefaultSkillRegistries.description: Stop Station from loading its built-in skill registries.

mcpUiHost.description: Render resolved MCP tool UIs in a sandboxed iframe (MCP Apps host). Default on.

surfaceTrustFromVeritasEvidence.description: Surface the trust bundle embedded in the latest Veritas evidence record as a project Trust bundle. Default on.

knowledgeStores.description: Register the K2 KnowledgeStoreProvider seam alongside the namespace-based knowledge path. Default off.

workspaceCheckpoints.description: Capture git snapshots of the session project's working directory at turn boundaries, stored as hidden refs pinned for 90 days. Default off; applies after a restart.

agentConnections.description: Per-agent connection overrides keyed by agent slug.

builtinAgentEngineConnectionId.description: Engine connection the built-in default agents are bound to (station#1194). Absent: re-derived each boot. null: explicitly Station, sticky. A connection id: explicitly that engine, sticky.

fleetContribution.description: Which local model connections this Station offers to your inference fleet (station#1398). Default off: absent, disabled, or an empty allowlist all contribute nothing.

enabled.description: Master opt-in. Must be exactly true; anything else is off.

connectionIds.description: Ids of the local model connections offered to the fleet. Explicit allowlist — never 'all local connections'.

contribution.description: What this Station offers per space (station#1500), keyed by scope key ("project:<projectId>"). Default off: absent, disabled, or empty allowlists all offer nothing. The "fleet" scope is NOT configured here — its one writable home is the fleetContribution setting. Key shape is deliberately NOT constrained here: this schema is validated on the config LOAD path (src-server/domain/config-loader-app.ts), so a pattern would turn a key written by a NEWER Station (a future "channel:..." scope) into an unloadable config after a downgrade — converting the graceful degradation parseContributionScopeKey exists to provide into a hard failure. PUT /config/app refuses an unusable key at the write, where the operator is present.

enabled.description: Master opt-in for this scope. Must be exactly true; anything else is off.

execution.description: Repo resource ids this Station offers to run work in. Explicit allowlist — never 'every repo I have checked out'.

agents.description: Agent slugs this Station makes available in this space. Explicit allowlist.

inference.description: Local model connection ids offered in this space. Explicit allowlist.

firstRun.description: Whether the guided first run has been offered on this home and what the person did with it (UX audit RT-02/SHELL-12). Absent means this home predates the field and the run is not offered; only a brand-new home is written with 'pending'.

userProfile.description: First-run 'About you' answers (station#2652). Absent means the questions were skipped or unanswered, and Station injects nothing.
